selection_structure.ATLAS: Chronic / rehabilitation-skewed sampling favors large MCA-territory lesions; agreement with acute cohorts is not fully independent confirmation of MCA biology.
selection_structure.ISLES22: Acute DWI lesions; LVO/thrombectomy selection also MCA-skewed. Higher VB-dominant fraction than ATLAS is descriptive cohort mix.
selection_structure.ADNI_WMH: Non-stroke SVD/WMH axis; TerritoryVoxels geography; not stroke selection. Mean MCA>ACA share claim; not majority-subject claim.

interpretation: Outcome is volume-normalized territorial burden (lesion/WMH voxels per territory voxel).
Geometry features are atlas-derived (constant within territory across subjects).
Unique territorial R² = joint − geometry; unique geometry = joint − territory; shared = G+T−joint.
Large shared component is expected if branching anatomy is developmentally specified.
